basic_info.description: Discover this beautifully renovated contemporary gem in Diamond Heights! A perfect blend of modern convenience & city living, this serene & stylish condo is an amazing value. Desirable open floor-plan is a delightful space for entertaining & relaxation. Well-appointed Kitchen w/ SS appliances, sophisticated finishes, & a lovely Breakfast Bar to savor your morning coffee or tea. The spacious, light-filled LR features a cozy fireplace to enjoy during gatherings or a quiet night at home. Bright & open Dining area can easily double as an office. Retreat to a peaceful Bedroom boasting airy natural light & ample closet space. Freshly polished Bath w/ elegant, modern finishes & convenient separate vanity area. New designer-selected paint, wood floors, recessed lighting, & updated light fixtures & finishes throughout bring a stylish & modern touch. A digital lock & building intercom system provide easy remote entry for guests/deliveries. Deeded 1-car parking in a secure, covered garage. Elevator & convenient laundry facility in the building. Prime location just steps to Diamond Heights Shopping Center, groceries, coffee shop, parks, & hiking trails. Easy access to public transit/freeways. Don't miss this rare opportunity to experience the best of SF living in this exceptional home!
